termination: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving 90 calendar days written notice.
liability_cap: The aggregate liability of the Supplier shall not exceed USD 100,000 in any contract year.
governing_law: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Hong Kong.
automatic_renewal: This Agreement will automatically renew for successive one-year terms.
audit_rights: The Customer has the right to audit the Supplier's service records on ten business days written notice.
assignment: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
insurance: The Supplier shall maintain commercial liability insurance with a limit of USD 1,000,000.
